creative_direction: Imagine a small desert observatory arranged as a thick sandstone ring around a still circular pool. A low glass dome covers one section of the ring, while a narrow stair descends toward the water. Present the building as a miniature on a cropped oval patch of sand, floating against a muted petrol background. Use sunlit ocher stone, turquoise water, and subtle cool glass reflections. Add fine recessed joints, a tiny shaded doorway, and a few wind-shaped sand ripples close to the base. Keep the ring geometry strong and the background empty. The scene should suggest quiet observation and shelter, without telescopes, figures, or a distant desert panorama.
